title: The Syria policy the US got wrong—and the bittersweet moment Washington finally got right
gist: Wa'el Alzayat, ex-State Department liaison to the Syrian opposition and head of the US-Syria Business Council, says the SDF's dissolution into the Syrian army, the rescinding of Syria's State Sponsor of Terrorism designation and HTS delisting, and repeal of Caesar Act sanctions end ~50 years of US economic isolation of Syria. He argues incoherent Obama-era policy (CIA backing rebels, Pentagon backing the YPG, refusing to engage Idlib/HTS) won against ISIS but lost Syria, and urges the US to now help build institutions and the economy.
